answer: Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, reset on any identity-link attempt, no identity may audit its own recruit. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. By the kernel of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Each submission hangs on the wharf of a task receipt, and the anchor is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
